rows.en: Touya: "There's something I want to ask..."
Clovis: "Sure. How to flirt with women?"
Touya: "...Don't lump me in with you.
It's about Aurelie."
Clovis: "What, how to flirt with Aurelie?
Now that's a difficult problem."
Touya: "Is that the only thing in your head?!"
Clovis: "Calm down. It's about what happened before, right?"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Clovis: "Have you asked her already?"
Touya: "Yeah. She said it was her problem and wouldn't answer.
I heard you cheered her up when she was down.
Hey, could it be that she... feels something for you...?"
Clovis: "...Touya. How do you feel
about her?"
Touya: "Huh? How do I...?"
Clovis: "If you're just worried, leave her alone
from now on. Otherwise, I'll answer you."
Touya: "?"
Clovis: "...Are you worried about her as a friend,
or as a woman? Which is it?"
Touya: "What?! Th-That's..."
Clovis: "..."
Well, as a friend...
Of course I care about her as more than a friend.
Clovis: "...Do you mean that?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Clovis: "..."
Touya: "..."
...The truth is, I see her as more than a friend.
Clovis: "...I see. All right."
Touya: "But I'm still worried about her..."
Clovis: "That isn't the point.
I'm sorry. Just forget it."
Yamato: "...We didn't get to hear it after all..."
Touya: "..."
Clovis: "I see...
All right. Then I'll tell you. To start with, she and I
aren't anything more than comrades.
But she does have feelings for someone like me.
I've been pretending not to notice all this time."
Touya: "...Why?"
Clovis: "I have no right to accept her feelings.
Not when I'm a man who couldn't protect the person he loved."
Touya: "The person you loved?"
Clovis: "My wife..."
Touya: "What?! You were married?!"
Clovis: "Yes."
Touya: "I see... Then that would be an affair... Hm?
But you said you couldn't protect her... Did she die?"
Clovis: "...Yes."
Touya: "...I-I'm sorry..."
Clovis: "...Don't worry about it.
To only realize how much she meant to me after she died...
I was a complete and utter fool..."
Touya: "...It wasn't that you didn't love her, right?"
Clovis: "...My wife, Elena, was the daughter of a superior officer when I was in the military.
Being the top ace had become something everyone took for granted.
I was under pressure, and I'd sunk so low that I turned to Elena's father's power
for help.
To secure my own position,
I used her."
Touya: "..."
Clovis: "She loved me, even when I was like that.
But at the time, I could only find it painful.
The guilt of using Elena, and the feeling of being trapped
in order to protect my position.
On the surface, I played the good husband.
...I was the lowest of the low."
Touya: "Could it be that your wife died because...?"
Clovis: "No. It was a traffic accident. At the time, she said it wasn't serious
and didn't even go to a hospital. But apparently she'd hit her head,
and she suddenly collapsed..."
Touya: "...And that was it?"
Clovis: "She regained consciousness once. Then she
smiled at me and said...
'You're free.'
Even when that had happened to her, she was thinking
of me before herself.
Elena held my hand as her consciousness faded. Her last
words were 'I love you.'
I was shaken. I regretted it all.
She understood everything, yet she still said she loved someone like me...
Those were her words."
Touya: "..."
Clovis: "None of our relatives or friends blamed me.
Instead, they offered me words of encouragement.
I couldn't bear it.
So I quit the military and turned away from reality.
I used despair as an excuse and ran away."
Touya: "But I couldn't imagine any of that
from the way you are now..."
Clovis: "The way I am now, I'm practically living a lie to myself.
Fighting is how I keep from losing myself.
Someone like that has no right to love anyone."
Touya: "So that's why you can't return Aurelie's feelings...
...Why did you tell me all that?"
Clovis: "Heh... Why, indeed?
Maybe I'm losing my edge."
Touya: "Hey, is that a dig at me?"
Clovis: "Ha ha. I'm joking.
...But I can't keep running away forever.
It might be time I had a proper talk with Aurelie."
Touya: "...But Aurelie feels... about you..."
Clovis: "She's someone who isn't used to being loved, either.
She's just mistaking kindness and admiration for love.
Besides, I don't think I can love anyone the way I am now.
That's how I really feel. I'm not running away.
If I accepted her feelings in this state,
I'd only hurt her. I've had enough
of making people sad."
Touya: "Will she be all right if you do that?
She puts on a brave front, but..."
Clovis: "That's why I'm telling you.
I think you're the first person she's told about herself.
She doesn't realize it, but that's proof she trusts you.
That's why I want you to support her."
Touya: "Me...?"
Clovis: "Were you lying before?"
Touya: "...No. You're right.
I don't know how much I can do, but..."
Clovis: "You can do it."
Touya: "You sound more confident than I am."
Clovis: "I like to think I'm a good judge of people."
Touya: "..."
Clovis: "..."
Touya: "...All right."
Clovis: "Good! That's the man I had faith in."
Touya: "But... Trying to cheer her up seems to have the opposite effect,
and I don't think I can do what you did
back then... What should I do?"
Clovis: "Figure that out yourself.
What do you have that head for?"
Touya: "That's so irresponsible..."
Clovis: "Well, that's how it is. I'm leaving it to you."
Touya: "H-Hey... Honestly..."
Yamato: "...This has turned into quite a problem."
Touya: "Yeah..."
